name: LOVE BOIN
source:
Main character gets to spend this summer with his large breast sister and wife. It's up to him whether one of them gets pregnant or things play out safely.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角将与他的大胸妹妹和妻子一起度过这个夏天。他们中的一个是否怀孕，或者事情能否顺利进行，都取决于他。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
